meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

howto.what: 向 NanoClaw 添加一个本地监控仪表盘，显示代理组、会话、通道、用户、令牌用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你需要为 NanoClaw 项目添加可视化监控仪表盘时触发。只需告诉 Claude 你的需求，它会指导你完成安装和配置步骤。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, displaying agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add a monitoring dashboard to your NanoClaw project. Claude will guide you through installing npm packages, modifying source code, and configuring environment variables.

say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the installation steps.
Claude will copy files and modify index.ts.
